name: Change
languages: all those of the creature who summoned it

traits.name: The Law of Change
traits.text:
Enemies with 10 feet cannot
benefit from magical healing.

traits.name: Chaos Vulnerability
traits.text:
The Inexorables have disadvantage
on all saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Inexorable
traits.text:
The Inexorables are immune to any
effects that would slow them or deny them
actions or movement.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text:
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to
hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit:
12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
